title: GET /api/agent/tasks?wait=N — 200 response (signed request; doubles as the heartbeat)

tasks.description: Queued tasks (empty until M3). Each carries a signed bundle (spec 7.3).

bundle.description: base64 of the exact UTF-8 JSON bytes that were signed.

pollAfter.description: Seconds to wait before the next poll.

serverTime.description: Lets the agent detect clock skew.
